description: Ferry the coast early, then use crawler and cooling inland: the bridge gets the research crew over crossing A before the lava; the coast village is ferried by two skiffs to two different landings (one launched at the coast dock, one from the high landing); the crawler loads six orchard residents and drives the long track with the last two walking behind, they wait at crossing B's safe bank, and crossing B is cooled in the final window (440 s).
